Professor Latimer has a natural talent to render even the most complicated problems of Medieval Europe, simple and easily comprehensible. Throughout the classes, he had skillfully framed the world of Medieval Europe from times of trouble and disintegration of the Roman Empire up to the early fruits of 'Renaissance'. This course mainly functions as a very broad survey of a thousand years and acquaints students with the major events of the period as well as informing them of the state of the art of academic literature on certain themes and topics. As someone who did not have any formal training in Medieval European History, I can say without a doubt that I feel a lot more confident in carrying out significant research in any aspect of Medieval Europe now, after only one semester.
